name: All-Atom Structure Tokenizer
description: A discrete all-atom structure tokenizer that encodes heavy-atom biomolecular assemblies into one integer token per chemical unit from a vocabulary of 8,192 IDs using finite scalar quantization, with a flow-matching coordinate decoder that reconstructs atomic coordinates.

attributes.access: Source code, an example and tests are released as a PyTorch reference implementation on Hugging Face; trained checkpoints are not distributed.
